description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Impose Special Commodity levy for Black Gram
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It is a regulatory order that modifies import duties and rescinds a previous order, falling squarely under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" which cover new regulations, statutory instruments, and legal amendments. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers, not detailing personal portfolio responsibilities or making a personnel appointment. The core content is regulatory/legal in nature.
